points.point: Numerology μ 定義 OFDM 的 time-frequency resolution，決定 OFDM symbol 時間長度與 Subcarrier Spacing（SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz）
points.label: covered
points.why: states μ determines symbol duration and SCS formula

points.point: Cyclic prefix 加在每個 OFDM symbol 前方作為 guard interval，用於消除 inter-symbol interference（ISI）；Normal CP 14 symbols/slot、Extended CP 12 symbols/slot
points.label: covered
points.why: states CP guard interval/ISI and 14/12 symbols per slot

points.point: OFDM 的 time-domain symbol 與 frequency-domain subcarriers 組成 resource grid，Resource Element 是 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port
points.label: covered
points.why: states resource grid and RE definition

points.point: OFDM 訊號因 many random QAM symbols 經 IFFT 線性組合而具有 high PAPR，需要 transmitter back-off PA 操作點，這驅動 UL 使用 DFT-s-OFDM / transform precoding 與 low-PAPR sequence
points.label: partial
points.why: covers QAM/IFFT high PAPR, misses PA back-off and UL DFT-s-OFDM/low-PAPR implications

points.point: OFDM waveform 的 sample rate 由 NFFT 與 SCS 決定（sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz），並對應到 maximum bandwidth，影響所需儀器頻寬
points.label: partial
points.why: gives sample-rate formula and bandwidth relevance, but not maximum-bandwidth mapping

points.point: 產品選件決策：OFDM 訊號產生與分析需專用 software option，例如 SMW200A 的 OFDM signal generation（K114）與 FSW 的 OFDM signal analysis（K96）
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions an OFDM analysis option, but misses referenced SMW K114/FSW K96 generation-analysis examples

points.point: Conformance 測項直接以 OFDM symbol 定義：TS 38.141-1 6.3.3 Total power dynamic range 是 OFDM symbol maximum 與 minimum transmit power 的差值（使用 TM2 / TM2a，Middle frequency）
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention TS 38.141-1 total power dynamic range symbol-defined test

points.point: 測試設定決策：OCNG pattern 以 OFDM resource grid 的 unused REs 為作用點（per-slot 14-bit OFDM symbol mask、RB resolution），用於 modelling unused resources 給 virtual UEs
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention OCNG unused RE pattern, symbol mask, or virtual UEs

invented: understanding OFDM numerology/SCS and bandwidth is necessary to choose and configure CMX-KM600 analyzer or CMX-KW601 generator measurements
